title: GRIN+: Towards Fast Yet Effective Machine Unlearning for Imbalanced Medical Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.15571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As deep learning models become fundamental to modern healthcare, the "Right to be Forgotten" mandated by privacy regulations like GDPR and HIPAA necessitates effective machine unlearning (MU) to remove sensitive patient data from trained models. However, existing MU techniques often struggle with a fundamental "privacy-efficiency-utility" (PEU) trilemma, particularly in medical scenarios where data is frequently characterized by severe class imbalance and long-tailed distributions. In such cases, standard unlearning methods can fail to protect key clinical knowledge or mistakenly delete features essential for diagnosing rare conditions due to the gradient dominance of majority classes. To address these challenges, we propose GRIN+, a novel machine unlearning framework designed for fast and precise data erasure in imbalanced medical scenarios. GRIN+ decouples unlearning-specific knowledge from generalized representations at the parameter

translated_title: GRIN+：迈向面向不平衡医疗数据的快速且高效的机器遗忘
translated_abstract: 随着深度学习模型成为现代医疗保健的基石，GDPR和HIPAA等隐私法规所规定的“被遗忘权”要求进行有效的机器遗忘（MU），以从训练好的模型中删除敏感的患者数据。然而，现有的机器遗忘技术常常难以应对“隐私-效率-效用”（PEU）三难困境，尤其是在数据普遍具有严重类别不平衡和长尾分布特征的医疗场景中。在这种情况下，由于多数类的梯度主导，标准的遗忘方法可能无法保护关键临床知识，或错误地删除对诊断罕见疾病至关重要的特征。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了GRIN+，这是一种新颖的机器遗忘框架，旨在不平衡医疗场景中实现快速且精确的数据擦除。GRIN+在参数层面将遗忘特定知识与广义表示解耦……
tldr: 提出GRIN+机器遗忘框架，通过将遗忘特定知识与广义表示解耦，解决不平衡医疗数据中“隐私-效率-效用”三难困境，实现对敏感患者数据的快速精确删除。
en_tdlr: GRIN+ is a novel machine unlearning framework that decouples unlearning-specific knowledge from generalized representations to achieve fast and precise erasure of sensitive patient data in imbalanced medical scenarios, addressing the privacy-efficiency-utility trilemma.
